candidate.rationale: Repair archive-slice-bounds mutation: reject interior surrogate-pair starts and move an interior end backward before the pair, matching inspected cases (xy😀z, max_chars=3 returns 'xy').

Replace stringified comparison with deep structural equality (isDeepStrictEqual), so nested values compare structurally and object member order is not semantic; preserves response_not_text, invalid_json, exact_json_match, and answer_mismatch behavior and exports.

Repair retention-tool-pair validation: require unique call IDs within each exchange and require each tool result's tool_call_id to match the assistant call at the same positional index, per evidence/cases.json requirements and examples (duplicate IDs, membership-only pairing, foreign IDs rejected). Preserves export, masking of old content, and recent-tail behavior.

Repair retention-long-window mutation: enforce call-ID uniqueness within each exchange and positional (index-wise) tool-result ID matching per contract requirements, instead of the mutated membership-only check and duplicate-tolerant validation. Masking window and all other behavior preserved.

Repair retention-tool-pairs validation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index, per contract requirements and cases (duplicate IDs, membership-only mismatch, and foreign-call cases must be rejected).

Replace JSON.stringify equality with isDeepStrictEqual so parsed JSON is compared structurally (object member order ignored; array order, types, missing/extra members significant), while preserving response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the exact_json_match/answer_mismatch reasons. No tests were run.
Repair slice-bounds mutation: reject interior surrogate starts, move an interior end back one unit before splitting a pair, and keep the empty-at-EOF allowance, preserving exports and other behavior.

Repair archive-slice-bounds mutation: reject interior-start splits, move interior-end backward before a surrogate pair, and reject a nonempty read with no progress; empty slice still allowed exactly at EOF.

Repair mutation: use structural deep equality (isDeepStrictEqual) instead of stringified comparison so equivalent objects with reordered keys pass, while array order, value types, and extra/missing members remain significant; preserve response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the exported API.

Enforce call-ID uniqueness within each exchange and positional one-to-one pairing of tool results to assistant calls (cases-09/10/13/14); membership-only check replaced. Masking and exports unchanged.

Repair the retention-long-window mutation: enforce one-to-one positional tool-call/result pairing (unique call IDs within each exchange; each tool result must match the assistant call at the same positional index rather than mere membership), keep the recent tail unchanged and mask only older observation content, preserving the export, hashing, masking metadata, and all other behavior.
